title: When Objectives and Evaluators Disagree: Evaluating Transfer for Post-hoc Demographic Framing Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25258v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-hoc rewriting is used to reduce demographic disparities in LLM-generated text when the source model is inaccessible. A rewrite can look successful merely because it improved its own target or satisfied its selector. We study this as a transfer problem on 660 gender pairs and 1,980 age contrasts of demographic-conditioned climate messages. A rewriter proposes edits, a selection model chooses among constraint-satisfying candidates, and an independent evaluator uninvolved in either rates pairwise framing disparity. A fixed policy that always targets the message with the lower Persuasion Bias Index (PBI) transfers inconsistently across axes and outcome aggregations. An adaptive policy that proposes edits on both sides but accepts at most one significantly improves on that rule, applied to the same candidates, in seven of eight comparisons across two evaluator families, mostly by editing more pairs, not by guided direction choice, at h

translated_title: 当目标与评估者不一致时：评估事后人口框架偏差缓解的迁移性
translated_abstract: 在源模型不可访问的情况下，事后重写被用于减少大语言模型生成文本中的人口群体差异。一次重写可能仅仅因为改善了自己的目标或满足了自己的选择器而显得成功。我们将其作为一个迁移问题进行研究，研究对象是660个性别对和1,980个年龄对比的人口条件化气候信息。重写器提出编辑，选择模型在满足约束条件的候选中进行挑选，而一个独立于两者的评估器对成对框架差异进行评分。总是针对说服偏差指数（PBI）较低的信息的固定策略，在不同维度和结果聚合方式之间的迁移表现不一致。一种在两侧都提出编辑但最多接受一个编辑的自适应策略，在应用于相同候选时，在两个评估器家族的八项比较中有七项显著优于该规则，其优势主要来自编辑了更多的信息对，而非引导编辑方向的选择。
tldr: 该研究将无法访问源模型时通过事后重写缓解大语言模型人口框架偏差视为迁移问题，发现总是针对说服偏差指数（PBI）较低信息的固定策略迁移不一致，而在两侧提出编辑但最多接受一个的自适应策略在两个评估器家族八项比较中的七项显著更优，且主要得益于编辑了更多对而非引导方向选择。
en_tdlr: Framing post-hoc demographic bias mitigation as a transfer problem, this study finds that an adaptive rewriting policy proposing edits on both sides but accepting at most one transfers significantly better across evaluators than a fixed policy targeting lower-PBI messages, mainly by editing more pairs rather than by guided direction choice.
